newsitem.title: USA: Kansas City, Mo., city manager to resign - media.
newsitem.headline: Kansas City, Mo., city manager to resign - media.

text.p: City Manager Larry Brown will offer to resign Thursday, according to local media reports.
Radio, television and newspapers said the Kansas City Council has scheduled a closed-door meeting later Thursday to talk about the terms of Brown's departure.
Brown and council members declined to comment on the reports.
Brown came to Kansas City in 1994 and has just over six months left on his contract, but his relationship with the council deteriorated in recent months.
It became evident in April that a majority of council members had become disenchanted with Brown's stewardship.

The council rejected much of his budget proposal by shifting $9.5 million out of Brown's plan to re-organize city government and put that money instead into long-delayed capital improvement projects in neighborhoods.
